stories.title: Pakistan, Turkey and Saudi Arabia activate their Mecca mutual-defense pact for the first time
stories.reason: Defense and foreign ministers meeting in Riyadh agreed to rapidly deploy forces to Saudi Arabia after Houthi strikes on Riyadh's airport and an Aramco refinery, invoking a NATO-style 'attack on one is an attack on all' clause for the first time since the pact was signed in August.

stories.title: Germany's Merz makes a surprise Kyiv visit, pledging over $1 billion in aid to Ukraine
stories.reason: Merz brought roughly ten German defense and energy executives on his second wartime visit, announcing drone-interceptor and energy-infrastructure funding plus a joint drone-production deal, even as Russia struck Kyiv during his stay.

stories.title: Trump draws bipartisan backlash after suggesting Iran could 'take out' Los Angeles or San Diego
stories.reason: California officials including Gov. Newsom called the rally remarks 'deranged and dangerous,' while the White House said Trump meant the US was fighting to prevent Iran from ever gaining that capability, underscoring how his unscripted rhetoric keeps outpacing his own administration's messaging.

stories.title: South Korea's Nuri rocket successfully launches a record 15 satellites in its first private-led flight
stories.reason: Hanwha Aerospace held full operational command for the first time as the rocket deployed five NEONSAT disaster-monitoring microsatellites and ten CubeSats, Nuri's largest payload since its 2021 debut and a step toward a homegrown satellite-constellation capability.

stories.title: Data on 850,000 members leaked after a hack at South Korea's largest Protestant church
stories.reason: Yoido Full Gospel Church's breach, alongside a similar hit on Seoul's Sarang Church, adds to a wave of intrusions that has already hit seven South Korean banks this month using AI-assisted techniques, prompting a nationwide security scramble.

stories.title: France's Mistral unveils a 1-trillion-parameter model it says beats China's best open AI systems
stories.reason: Mistral Large 4, nicknamed 'Le Chonk,' is in preview for developers and government users ahead of a full October 27 release, positioning the French lab as Europe's answer in the three-way race with US and Chinese open-weight models.

stories.title: C.H. Robinson agrees to acquire logistics rival RXO for $5.8 billion
stories.reason: The stock-and-cash deal creates a combined freight brokerage worth more than $25 billion in enterprise value and is expected to generate $300 million in cost savings within two years by applying C.H. Robinson's AI-driven operating model to RXO's last-mile network.

stories.title: Anthropic expands its Claude Startups program with up to $45,000 in partner perks
stories.reason: Eligible early-stage founders now get a free year of Claude Team, $1,000 in API credits and discounts through a new partner stack, the latest move by a major AI lab to lock in developer loyalty as competition for startup mindshare intensifies.
